_comment: Canonical app envelopes for hardware/public-consumption lanes. Each app composes existing fleet utilities instead of asking hardware to consume loose packages directly.

utilityBands.label: Public Tool Gateway
utilityBands.hardwarePurpose: Give the machine one authenticated HoloScript tool doorway instead of many loose APIs.
utilityBands.publicRole: MCP/HoloKey tool access, HoloMesh coordination, and fleet dispatch control.

utilityBands.label: Headless Agent Runtime
utilityBands.hardwarePurpose: Let the machine keep working when no browser or IDE is open.
utilityBands.publicRole: Unattended HoloMesh agent process and portable execution worker.

utilityBands.label: Local Language Runtime
utilityBands.hardwarePurpose: Make the machine able to parse, validate, run, and compile HoloScript source locally.
utilityBands.publicRole: HoloScript CLI plus core parser, AST, compiler, and trait substrate.

utilityBands.label: Sovereign AI Serving
utilityBands.hardwarePurpose: Turn owned hardware into a model-serving node when weights and runtime assets are present.
utilityBands.publicRole: HoloLlama serving plans, launch bundles, lifecycle proofs, and device registry artifacts.

utilityBands.label: Sovereign Memory And Identity
utilityBands.hardwarePurpose: Keep memory and identity portable across local, edge, and fleet contexts.
utilityBands.publicRole: Identity-keyed shared memory client for sibling agent families.

utilityBands.label: Semantic Proof Harness
utilityBands.hardwarePurpose: Give the machine a receipt-producing cognition and semantic validation lane.
utilityBands.publicRole: uAAL semantic gates, cognitive-cycle primitives, and recovery receipts.

utilityBands.label: XR Embodiment Runtime
utilityBands.hardwarePurpose: Let hardware participate in spatial presence rather than only backend jobs.
utilityBands.publicRole: Shared locomotion, avatar substrate, and WebXR/agent embodiment support.

utilityBands.label: Python Science Runtime
utilityBands.hardwarePurpose: Support scientific, robotics, and notebook-adjacent use without turning npm packages into Python glue.
utilityBands.publicRole: Python HoloScript bindings for scripts, robotics, and scientific utilities.

utilityBands.label: Python Trait Inference
utilityBands.hardwarePurpose: Run model-backed trait classification only on lanes that declare that workload.
utilityBands.publicRole: Trait inference CLI and GPU-capable Python model utility.

utilityBands.label: GPU Fleet Dispatch
utilityBands.hardwarePurpose: Move expensive or accelerated work through preview-first fleet controls.
utilityBands.publicRole: HoloCI, world-render, and paid simulation dispatch receipts.

telemetrySignals.label: Capability Inventory Snapshot
telemetrySignals.captureCadence: on manifest change, before public readiness claims, and after package lane changes
telemetrySignals.retention: durable commit evidence plus the latest package/fleet gate receipt
telemetrySignals.privacyBoundary: package names, utility ids, app ids, and validation status only
telemetrySignals.failureMode: mark capability inventory stale; do not claim a hardware app is public-ready

telemetrySignals.label: Runtime Metrics Snapshot
telemetrySignals.captureCadence: continuous service scrape where deployed, and on every readiness check
telemetrySignals.retention: aggregate snapshots only; durable receipt when readiness changes
telemetrySignals.privacyBoundary: counters, gauges, and latency histograms only; no prompts, secrets, file contents, or model weights
telemetrySignals.failureMode: mark telemetry_unknown and block continuous-observability claims

telemetrySignals.label: Hardware Sync Handshake
telemetrySignals.captureCadence: on boot, before physical-world actuation, and after ROS2 bridge changes
telemetrySignals.retention: latest connected or honest-stub handshake receipt per node
telemetrySignals.privacyBoundary: node name, topic prefix, connection status, latency, and topic/type lists only
telemetrySignals.failureMode: return honest stub or ros2_bridge_unreachable; never gate safety decisions on contractVerified=false

telemetrySignals.label: Model Serving Lifecycle

source.command: HoloLlama doctor, lifecycle, and mesh-readonly bridge receipts

telemetrySignals.captureCadence: on boot, after model/runtime changes, and before claiming owned inference
telemetrySignals.retention: latest HoloLlama plan, lifecycle, and node proof per hardware profile
telemetrySignals.privacyBoundary: model identity, runtime health, endpoint status, and registry metadata only; no weights or prompts
telemetrySignals.failureMode: claim planning-only HoloLlama capability until live lifecycle proof exists

telemetrySignals.label: Agent Activity Heartbeat
telemetrySignals.captureCadence: on agent start and periodically while the app is active
telemetrySignals.retention: latest heartbeat and last durable room/board/receipt reference
telemetrySignals.privacyBoundary: agent id, app id, status, task references, and receipt ids only
telemetrySignals.failureMode: mark agent presence unknown; do not claim unattended operation

telemetrySignals.label: Resource Budget Snapshot
telemetrySignals.captureCadence: before heavy local work, after driver/runtime changes, and before public hardware claims
telemetrySignals.retention: latest local hardware audit receipt per physical host
telemetrySignals.privacyBoundary: hardware class, CPU/GPU/memory/disk/WebGPU capability, and pass/fail status only
telemetrySignals.failureMode: mark resource budget unknown and avoid performance/accelerator claims

telemetrySignals.label: Fleet Dispatch Preflight
telemetrySignals.captureCadence: before paid or credentialed dispatch and after spend-policy changes
telemetrySignals.retention: durable preview, spend-cap, verifier, and output-verified receipt per dispatch
telemetrySignals.privacyBoundary: job target, criteria, verifier, spend-cap status, and receipt ids only
telemetrySignals.failureMode: fail closed; no paid dispatch without a valid preflight receipt

telemetrySignals.label: HoloLand Runtime Receipt
telemetrySignals.captureCadence: after world/runtime validation, XR session checks, or app readiness changes
telemetrySignals.retention: durable validation receipt linked to world, shard, or app surface
telemetrySignals.privacyBoundary: runtime ids, validation outcome, hashes, and receipt metadata only
telemetrySignals.failureMode: do not claim HoloLand/XR runtime readiness without a passing receipt

telemetrySignals.label: Twin Earth Substrate Receipt
telemetrySignals.captureCadence: after physical-world, robot, AI, or substrate-bound actions
telemetrySignals.retention: durable action receipt with actor, envelope, scope, status, and hash
telemetrySignals.privacyBoundary: actor id, action, scope, status, envelope id, hashes, and timestamps only
telemetrySignals.failureMode: no physical-world or substrate-bound success claim without an action receipt

telemetrySignals.label: Hosted Service Health
telemetrySignals.captureCadence: continuous uptime scrape and before public hosted readiness claims
telemetrySignals.retention: latest health receipt plus deployment/status evidence
telemetrySignals.privacyBoundary: service status, version, health fields, and public tool inventory metadata only
telemetrySignals.failureMode: mark hosted coordinator degraded; local repo proof does not replace live service health

apps.label: HoloShell Workstation
apps.description: Founder laptop/HoloShell envelope for local custody, reasoning, validation, HoloMesh actions, Studio access, and overflow owned-metal work.

publicConsumption.primaryInstallSurface: Desktop launcher plus local API/MCP custody surface
publicConsumption.onboardingGoal: Open one local workstation surface that can author, validate, route, and prove HoloScript work without asking the user to assemble packages by hand.
mustNotClaim: Do not claim live Jetson or hosted service readiness from workstation-only checks.
Do not imply cloud LLM sessions are sovereign model serving.

continuousCapability.staleAfter: 24h for repo/package proof; 5m for live runtime telemetry; immediate after launcher, model, or credential changes
continuousCapability.retentionPolicy: keep durable readiness receipts; keep live metrics aggregate-only and rotate raw local snapshots
continuousCapability.privacyBoundary: never capture secrets, prompts, private file contents, OAuth state, model weights, or raw user media
continuousCapability.failureResponse: degrade to local manual-verifier mode and block public continuous-operation claims

publicEntrySurfaces: HoloShell local API and MCP custody surface
HoloScript CLI and local package runtime
caveats: Desktop launcher and Jetson message ingress are live-environment checks, not repo-only proofs.
Cloud LLM routes remain sessions; owned HoloLlama routes are the sovereignty path.

apps.label: Jetson Node City
apps.description: Owned-metal Jetson envelope for always-on HoloShell/Brittney ingress, HoloLlama serving, edge tools, memory, XR embodiment, and source projection.

publicConsumption.persona: Edge-node owner or lab hardware operator
publicConsumption.primaryInstallSurface: Systemd appliance with HoloShell, HoloLlama, and edge MCP endpoints
publicConsumption.onboardingGoal: Make the Jetson feel like one owned HoloScript node for ingress, local serving, memory, and source projection.
mustNotClaim: Do not claim live node readiness without Jetson runtime and node-home receipts.
Do not claim bundled model serving unless weights and llama.cpp binaries are installed and checked.

continuousCapability.staleAfter: 5m for node health; 24h for package proof; immediate after bridge, model, or systemd changes
readinessRequires: model lifecycle receipt when serving is claimed
contractVerified hardware handshake before physical sync claims
continuousCapability.retentionPolicy: keep durable node, model, and substrate receipts; keep runtime telemetry aggregate-only
continuousCapability.privacyBoundary: never capture secrets, private files, model weights, prompts, raw camera frames, or raw robot payloads
continuousCapability.failureResponse: mark the node degraded and refuse physical-world readiness claims until a fresh live receipt exists

caveats: Repo checks prove package shape; node-home and runtime appliance checks prove the live Jetson.
Model weights and llama.cpp binaries are operational assets, not bundled package contents.

apps.label: Vast GPU Worker
apps.description: Vast.ai GPU worker envelope for HoloCI, render, simulation dispatch, model workloads, HoloLlama planning, and Python trait inference.

publicConsumption.persona: GPU worker operator and accelerated-job dispatcher
publicConsumption.primaryInstallSurface: Fleet worker bootstrap with HoloCI, render, simulation, Python, and HoloLlama tooling
publicConsumption.onboardingGoal: Turn a rented or owned GPU machine into a receipt-producing worker with preview-first spend controls.
mustNotClaim: Do not run paid compute without a free-first preflight receipt and spend authority.
Do not claim live model throughput without mounted weights and runtime health proof.

continuousCapability.staleAfter: per job for dispatch proof; 5m for worker health; immediate after GPU image, driver, model, or spend-policy changes
continuousCapability.retentionPolicy: keep job receipts and spend-preflight evidence; keep metrics aggregate-only by worker/app id
continuousCapability.privacyBoundary: never capture secrets, paid credentials, model weights, prompts, raw simulation input, or private outputs
continuousCapability.failureResponse: fail closed for paid dispatch and downgrade GPU claims to unknown until proof is refreshed

caveats: Paid compute needs free-first proof and spend-cap authority before dispatch.
HoloLlama can plan Vast serving, but live model proof depends on mounted weights and runtime health.

apps.label: Hosted Coordinator
apps.description: Hosted MCP/orchestrator envelope for authenticated tool access, HoloCI dispatch, world rendering dispatch, and paid simulation dispatch.

publicConsumption.persona: Public API consumer or fleet coordinator
publicConsumption.onboardingGoal: Expose one authenticated public control plane for tools and fleet dispatch without leaking local repo or secret custody assumptions.
mustNotClaim: Do not treat hosted MCP status as local repo authority.
Do not expose credentialed or paid dispatch without preview-first, fail-closed controls.

continuousCapability.staleAfter: 5m for public health; per dispatch for paid or credentialed actions; immediate after deploy
readinessRequires: preview-first dispatch receipt before fleet actions
continuousCapability.retentionPolicy: keep public health and dispatch receipts; keep telemetry aggregate-only and scrub credential-bearing payloads
continuousCapability.privacyBoundary: never capture API keys, OAuth state, HoloKey secrets, prompts, private file contents, or customer payload bodies
continuousCapability.failureResponse: degrade hosted status and fail closed around credentialed or paid dispatch

caveats: Hosted MCP status is not local repo authority; local Absorb/cache status still needs repo-local proof.
Public hosted dispatch must stay preview-first and fail closed around credentials and spend.
